recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a presentation change in Kindling or the FHIR Extension Pack; FHIR-core source does not need a fix for this issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core request to show the path where common extensions apply when listing extensions for a resource; resolution was to do what was possible within space limits.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 14603, which maps to git-svn commit ea148b19deac685884ab8a4df69d68ab6924c051. That commit added a context column and presentContext/appliesTo logic to the old PageProcessor resource extension-list renderer.
additional_context: The old PageProcessor source was later replaced by the Gradle build dependency on org.hl7.fhir:kindling. Current core source still has active extension/profile inputs and generated placeholders, while resource-specific extension listings are now rendered in the FHIR Extension Pack. Bundle extension definitions there carry context expressions such as Bundle.entry.response and Bundle.entry.search, and the current CI Extension Pack page renders them in a Context column. Related FHIR-17031 has already been audited separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source change is needed because the requested path/context rendering is already present in the current specification surface and the renderer is no longer maintained as an in-repository core source file.
